name: Kentrosaurus
sum: Kentrosaurus is a small stegosaurid from the Late Jurassic Tendaguru Formation of Tanzania, known from hundreds of bones.
wsnote: Adult ranges given in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: Syntype series from the German Tendaguru expeditions of 1909–1912, now mostly in the Museum für Naturkunde Berlin.
material: Hundreds of bones, roughly 350 remaining specimens in Berlin; no complete skeleton is known.
biology: Small elongated head with a beak for biting plants, a large gut, and a probably double row of small plates on neck and back merging into spikes at hip and tail.
author: Hennig 1915
